basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old amateur plant enthusiast living in Bristol, UK. By day, I'm an air traffic controller, which keeps me on my toes and requires a lot of precision and focus. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the world of houseplants, especially those that can thrive in my cozy apartment. I have recently started following the Minnesota Wild hockey team after a trip to the US, and I love catching their games when I can. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings either watching hockey or researching the best ways to care for my growing plant collection. I'm usually online in the evenings after my shifts and late into the night when the Wild are playing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of air traffic control due to my professional training and experience. My knowledge of houseplants is more recent, cultivated through online research and community forums. I'm still learning and often seek advice from more experienced plant owners.
